Config A (No Quality Governance).description: Blind task execution; declares success whenever agent tasks terminate without evaluating regressions.
Config A (No Quality Governance).tradeoff_profile: Minimal execution cost and high apparent completion, but high latent risk and blind debt accumulation.

Config B (Single-Score Quality).description: Scalar metric average collapses all dimensions into a single authority number (e.g. 82%).
Config B (Single-Score Quality).tradeoff_profile: Reduces obvious syntax failures, but allows critical regressions to hide behind high average scores in other dimensions.

Config C (Multidimensional Quality witho.description: Evaluates all 9 dimensions separately, but lacks temporal/structural debt lifecycle management.
Config C (Multidimensional Quality witho.tradeoff_profile: High regression sensitivity, but one-off threshold breaches cause alert fatigue without structural debt amortization.

Config D (Full F68 Governed Quality Debt.description: 9 dimensions observed + structural/temporal debt lifecycle + budget enforcement + 5-state nuanced gates.
Config D (Full F68 Governed Quality Debt.tradeoff_profile: Zero false quality approvals and complete regression capture, at the cost of higher verification runtime and bounded human escalation.
